items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: I'd be glad to say it, Trummy Young. Note for note. He came and told me, he said, "I'm going to steal every thing that I can from you."

ctx.x: You influenced like most of the trombone players since your time, I mean you've been like one of the major influences in jazz, I said and you have influenced so many young trombone players, I mean trombone players since your playing. What are some of the trombone players that you've listened to that you also we impressed by their playing ... or even younger ones.

I'd be glad to say it, Trummy Young. Note for note. He came and told me, he said, "I'm going to steal every thing that I can from you." And I said, "Thank you." It made me work harder. I have a record I made back there over in Denmark and the guy, I have his picture there, he sent for me. He owned a chocolate factory over there and he was a very nice guy.
